queries:
SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount)
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.event_name;
SELECT event_name, AVG(attendance_count) AS average_attendance
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendance_count
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
GROUP BY event_name;
SELECT *
FROM budget
INNER JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id;
SELECT AVG(avg_amount)
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_name
)
WHERE avg_amount IS NOT NULL;
SELECT CAST(COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS average_attendance
FROM event e
LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event;
SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.event_name
HAVING AVG(b.spent) > (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM budget);
